''See also: [[Mad King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Mad King, formerly known as the hero [[Daruman]], is a legendary and highly dangerous figure characterized by his intense hatred for the [[Abidan]]. Once an [[Executor]] recruited by the [[Abidan]] to intervene in various worlds, his will was eventually corrupted by [[Oth’kimeth]], leading the [[Court]] to bestow upon him his current title. He is considered a Class One threat due to his ability to potentially cross [[Way|the Way]] without detection and his history of killing [[Judges]]. In combat, he is a devastating force, often appearing in bone armor with burning red eyes. He wields a black [[The Scythe|Scythe]] and a bone [[sword]] that carries the sorrow of destroyed worlds, capable of slicing through entire [[Iterations]]. His presence is so powerful that it warps the laws of the universe and distorts [[Fate]] itself. He has a history of waging solo wars that toppled cities and blighted entire forests, even earning a reputation as the [[Reaper]]. The Mad King resides in his citadel within the [[fortress]]-world of [[Tal’gullour]]. While he is a ruthless conqueror and imperialist who seeks to destroy the pillars of Heaven, he also demonstrates a protective love for his people and his world. He has utilized various methods to destabilize the [[Abidan]], including testing their response times by striking multiple worlds and spreading a cursed virus to create chaos. Despite his immense power, he has faced significant damage in battles against figures like [[Makiel]] and Ozriel, which has left his physical form and [[madra channels]] scarred and weakened.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Mad King is an old enemy of Ozriel, with whom he has fought and clashed swords. He also shares a connection with [[Li Markuth]], to whom he made promises and who subsequently cursed him. Additionally, [[Vall]] lost an eye during a battle against the Mad King, while [[Judge Suriel|Suriel]] intends to meet him.}}
